full_name: Karin B. Michels | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Karin B. Michels is the chair of the Department of Epidemiology at the UCLA Fielding School of Public Health, in Los Angeles. She is an epigenetic epidemiologist and explores how perinatal events shape our chronic disease risk.
